title: Permutation invariance of a function
statement: Let $f$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to a type $ eta$. The function is symmetric if permuting the coordinates of any input leaves its value unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: The function has domain the $n$-dimensional sign cube and codomain $ eta$.
